# North Carolina Medical Society

> The North Carolina Medical Society unites physicians and healthcare teams across NC with membership services, professional development, advocacy, and charitable initiatives.

NCMS serves as the leading voice for medicine in North Carolina, providing member resources, continuing education, healthcare policy advocacy, and philanthropic programs through the NCMS Foundation. The organization connects diverse physician specialties and supports healthcare access across the state.

- [Membership Center](https://www2.ncmedsoc.org/pages/membership-main-landing): NCMS membership enrollment and renewal center for physicians and healthcare professionals
- [Member Login Portal](https://www2.ncmedsoc.org/ncmsf-bot-2): Secure login to the NCMS online community for members
